about.title: About Crum
about.text:
Crum is a dessert kitchen with a deliberately short menu: Tiramisu and Classic Lotus Crumb.

Each is offered in three sizes, from a Single Serving for a quiet evening to a Dawat Serving for the whole table, and delivered across Lahore.

policies.howto:
1. Choose a dessert and size, and add it to your cart.
2. Enter your delivery address in Lahore and place the order. Nothing is paid at checkout.
3. We accept your order on WhatsApp from our official number.
4. Orders under Rs 3,000 are paid in cash on delivery. For larger orders, send the 50% advance and the screenshot in the same chat.
5. We deliver on the date you choose. Any balance is paid on delivery.
policies.refund:
• Cancel before we start preparing your order and any advance is refunded in full.
• If we cancel your order or cannot deliver it, any advance is refunded in full.
• Once preparation has started, the advance is non-refundable.
• If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, send a photo on the day of delivery. We will replace it or refund you.
policies.terms:
• We deliver within Lahore only.
• Prices are in Pakistani Rupees and may change.
• Desserts are perishable. Keep them refrigerated and enjoy them fresh.
• Orders under Rs 3,000 are paid in cash on delivery. Orders of Rs 3,000 or more are confirmed once a 50% advance is received; the balance is paid on delivery.
• The delivery fare is paid to the rider.
policies.privacy: Your name, phone number and address are used only to process and deliver your order. We do not share them with anyone except the rider who delivers your order.
